meta.title: LedgerFlow
meta.description: Accounting productivity workspace for accountants and small firms — clients, documents, invoices and deadlines in one auditable place.

landing.title: LedgerFlow
landing.description: Accounting productivity workspace for accountants and small firms — clients, documents, invoices and deadlines in one auditable place.
landing.note: The client workspace is the first production slice. Documents, invoices and tasks follow.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Your LedgerFlow workspace.
dashboard.quickBody: Jump into the modules available today.

meta.title: Create your workspace
meta.description: Set up your firm's LedgerFlow workspace.

onboarding.title: Create your workspace
onboarding.description: A workspace holds your firm's clients, team, documents and deadlines. You can invite teammates once it is created.
onboarding.footer: Your workspace is private to your firm. You can be a member of several workspaces later.
onboarding.benefitClients: Client records scoped to your firm
onboarding.benefitTeam: Roles and invitations for your team
onboarding.benefitAudit: An auditable trail of important actions

form.title: Firm details
form.description: Use the name your clients know.
form.nameHint: Welcome, {name}. This name appears in the workspace header.
form.nameRequired: Enter a firm name with at least 2 characters.
form.saveFailed: Could not create the workspace. Try again.
form.alreadyJoined: This account already belongs to a workspace.
form.networkError: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Access your firm's workspace.
login.verifiedNotice: Your email is verified. You can sign in.
login.resetNotice: Your password has been updated. Sign in with the new one.
login.registeredNotice: Account created. Check your inbox to activate it.
login.unverifiedBody: Your email is not verified yet. Resend the verification link.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Set up your access to the accounting workspace.
register.passwordHint: At least 12 characters, including a letter and a number.
register.successBody: We sent a verification link to {email}.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link.
forgot.successBody: If an account exists for this address, a reset link has been sent.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Choose a strong password for your account.
reset.successBody: You can now sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidBody: Request a new reset link to continue.

verify.title: Email verification
verify.subtitle: Confirm your address to activate your account.
verify.successBody: Your account is active. Welcome to LedgerFlow.
verify.errorBody: Request a new verification link below.
verify.resendBody: Enter your email to receive a new link.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.emailNotVerified: Verify your email before signing in.
errors.nameTooShort: Name must be at least 2 characters.

meta.listDescription: Browse, search and manage the clients of your firm.
meta.newDescription: Create a client record for your firm.

list.title: Clients
list.description: Manage the individuals and companies your firm works with. Search by name, contact details, tax identifiers or city.
list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No clients} one {# client} other {# clients}}
list.countFiltered: {count, plural, =0 {No matching clients} one {# client matching filters} other {# clients matching filters}}
list.emptyFilteredDescription: Try a different search term, status or client type — or clear the filters to see everyone.
list.emptyDescription: Create your first client to start organising documents, invoices and deadlines around them.

archive.archiveConfirm: Archive this client? It will be hidden from the default list but its data is kept.
archive.restoreConfirm: Restore this client to the active list?
archive.networkError: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

form.identityDescription: Client type and the name shown in your workspace.
form.legalDescription: Tax identifiers and commercial register, as provided.
form.fixErrors: Correct the highlighted fields before saving.
form.missingId: The client was saved but its identifier is missing.
form.networkError: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

detail.archived: This client is archived and hidden from the default list. Use Restore to bring it back.
detail.relatedNote: Documents, invoices and tasks will be linked to this client as their modules ship.
detail.notFoundDescription: This client does not exist or does not belong to your firm.

new.title: New client
new.description: Only the name is required. You can complete the contact, legal and address details later.

edit.title: Edit client
edit.description: Changes are visible to everyone in your firm as soon as you save.

error.title: Could not load clients
error.description: Something went wrong. Try again or refresh the page.

meta.title: Team
meta.description: Manage the members and invitations of your firm.

team.title: Team
team.description: Everyone here shares the same clients, documents and deadlines. Roles decide what each person can change.
team.membersDescription: {count, plural, =0 {No members yet} one {# member} other {# members}}
team.inviteDescription: They receive an email with a link to join this workspace.
team.revokeConfirm: Revoke this invitation? The link will stop working.
team.revokeFailed: Could not revoke the invitation. Try again.

invite.failed: Could not send the invitation. Try again.
invite.networkError: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
invite.hint: Invitations expire after 7 days. The person must sign in with the invited email address to accept.

accept.title: Join the workspace
accept.description: {inviter} invited you to join {firm} on LedgerFlow.
accept.failed: Could not accept the invitation. Try again.
accept.networkError: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
accept.notFoundBody: This link is invalid. Ask an administrator to send a new invitation.
accept.expiredBody: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask an administrator to send a new one.
accept.alreadyAcceptedBody: This invitation has already been accepted.
accept.mismatchBody: This invitation was sent to {email}. Sign in with that address to accept it.
accept.wrongAccount: Signed in as {email}. Switch account to accept a different invitation.
